method: Fresh primary-source checks for every entry. Prior reports supplied URL leads only. Publisher metadata, primary abstracts and full text were read at the depth needed for each use. Availability and repository-generated numbers are not inferred from citation authenticity. Case, TeX protection, journal-name abbreviations and author initials are normalized for comparison.
